slides.headline: Google added voice to Gemini
slides.body: Gemini 3.8 now turns any text into spoken audio using natural-sounding voices.

slides.headline: It reads articles, emails, PDFs
slides.body: Paste a link or upload a file and Gemini reads it back while you do other things.

slides.headline: Hands-free help for daily tasks
slides.body: Listen to news while cooking, emails while driving, or documents while resting your eyes.

slides.headline: Limited to Google apps for now
slides.body: Only works inside Gmail, Docs, and Chrome. Fewer languages than rivals like ElevenLabs.

slides.headline: Want more AI updates?
slides.body: Follow for plain-English AI news every week.
